entry.title: Council & government · Tue, Sep 8, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Bonds, Performance Report, Department Assessment, and Monthly Budget. The City Manager's report scheduled briefings regarding the Davenport Plan of Finance for 2026 General Obligation Bonds, the 2026 Consolidated Annual Performance and Evaluation Report, a Planning, Building and Development Assessment, and the July Monthly Budget Report.
Adopted: VDSS Cost-of-Living Adjustment Funding Acceptance and Allocation. Council adopted an ordinance accepting and allocating a cost-of-living adjustment from the Virginia Department of Social Services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS Funding for Family Services Specialists Pay Band Salary Increase. Council approved an ordinance accepting and allocating funding from the Virginia Department of Social Services for a pay band salary increase for Family Services Specialists. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: VDSS One-Time Bonus Funding Acceptance and Allocation. City Council passed an ordinance accepting and allocating a one-time bonus from the Virginia Department of Social Services. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: City Manager Comments on Leadership Retreat, Wasena Bridge, and Emergency Preparedness. The City Manager provided updates reporting on a department directors' leadership retreat held at RoVa Labs on September 2-3, progress on the Wasena Bridge Replacement project (approximately 95% complete with reopening expected in the coming weeks), and activities for National Preparedness Month involving Emergency Management and Stormwater teams.
Discussion / report: City Attorney Briefing on Youth Athletics Review Board Code Amendment. The City Attorney scheduled a 10-minute briefing on a code amendment to Section 2-316 concerning the Youth Athletics Review Board.

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Aug 17, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: City Manager Briefings on Arts, Williamson Road, and Performance Dashboard. The City Manager presented briefings to City Council regarding the Annual Arts and Culture Briefing and FY 2027 Public Art Workplan, a Williamson Road update, and Performance Dashboard Metrics.
Discussion / report: City Manager Report on ACFR Presentation and Audit Findings. The City Manager updated Council on the Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR), explaining presentation delays caused by finance staffing turnover and a financial system implementation. The report noted audit findings and ongoing corrective actions before an upcoming presentation by external auditors in September.

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Sep 21, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Presentation on Collective Bargaining by Roanoke Firefighters Association. The Roanoke Firefighters Association delivered a presentation to share information on collective bargaining, presented by President and Spokesperson Todd Reighley and sponsored by Council Members Sanchez-Jones and Nash. Council received and filed the presentation.
Adopted: Ordinance Amending Code Section Regarding Youth Athletics Review Board. City Council voted 6-1 to adopt an ordinance amending and reordaining Section 2-316 (Youth athletics review board) under Article XIV, Chapter 2 of the Code of the City of Roanoke. Vice-Mayor McGuire voted in opposition. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Adopted: Creation of Temporary Ad Hoc Professional Standards Committee. City Council passed Resolution No. 43475-092126 creating a temporary ad hoc Professional Standards Committee by a 6-1 vote, with Vice-Mayor McGuire voting against. Recorded vote: 6-1.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6565,plainText=false)

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Aug 3, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Municipal North Lobby Security Door Installation. The City Manager announced the start of installation of new security doors in the Municipal North Lobby to enhance building safety, utilizing overnight work, employee badge access, and visitor escorts.

entry.title: Council & government · Mon, Oct 19, 2026
entry.summary:
Discussion / report: Roanoke Cultural Endowment Update. Roanoke Cultural Endowment Executive Director Shaleen Powell presented an update to City Council, sponsored by Mayor Cobb and Council Member Volosin, which was received and filed.
Discussion / report: Arts and Culture Plan 2026 Briefing. The City Manager provided a 15-minute briefing to City Council regarding the Arts and Culture Plan 2026.
Adopted: National League of Cities City Summit Voting Delegate Designation. Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43484-101926, designating a Voting Delegate and Alternate Voting Delegate for the National League of Cities City Summit Annual Business Meeting. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Adopted: Economic Development Authority Director Appointment. Council voted 7-0 to adopt Resolution No. 43485-101926, appointing a Director to the Economic Development Authority for the City of Roanoke. Recorded vote: 7-0.
Discussion / report: Proposed Committees for Railroad Transition and Onzlee Ware Plaza. Council Member Volosin suggested forming a Railroad Transition Committee regarding the Norfolk Southern and Union Pacific merger, as well as a committee for the state-funded Onzlee Ware Plaza at the courthouse. Mayor Cobb advised establishing an appointment process.
Discussion / report: Roanoke Neighborhood Advocates Annual Report. Representatives from Roanoke Neighborhood Advocates and the Neighborhood Services Coordinator presented the board's annual report and activities to City Council.
Official source: https://roanokeva.api.civicclerk.com/v1/Meetings/GetMeetingFileStream(fileId=6588,plainText=false)
